zh: 他跑得非常快。
en: He runs very {fast|quickly}.

zh: 她每天都刻苦训练。
en: She trains {hard} every day.

zh: 上周六我们差点赢了比赛。
en: We {nearly|almost} won the game last Saturday.

zh: 我偶尔和邻居打网球。
en: I {occasionally|sometimes} play tennis with my neighbour.

zh: 我每周去两次健身房。
en: I go to the gym {twice} a week.

zh: 跑步前轻轻地拉伸一下腿部。
en: Stretch your legs {gently|lightly} before you run.

zh: 球队上半场踢得很差。
en: The team played {badly|poorly|terribly} in the first half.

zh: 就她这个年纪来说，她的体能好得令人难以置信。
en: She's {incredibly|unbelievably|amazingly} fit for someone her age.

zh: 我最近都没去游泳。
en: I haven't been swimming {lately|recently}.

zh: 全黑队轻松获胜。
en: The All Blacks won {easily|comfortably}.

zh: 两支球队势均力敌。
en: The two teams were {evenly|equally} matched.

zh: 跑完那一趟，我彻底累垮了。
en: I'm {totally|completely|absolutely|utterly} exhausted after that run.

zh: 裁判对那个进球的判罚明显错了。
en: The referee was {clearly|obviously} wrong about that goal.

zh: 他故意踢了对方球员。
en: He {deliberately|intentionally|purposely} kicked the other player.

zh: 昨天徒步之后，我几乎走不动路了。
en: I can {hardly|barely} walk after yesterday's hike.

zh: 我们输了，但打得很好。
en: We lost, but we played {well}.

zh: 我的体能正在逐渐提高。
en: My fitness is {gradually|slowly|steadily} improving.

zh: 幸运的是，自行车比赛中没人受伤。
en: {Fortunately|Luckily|Thankfully}, nobody was hurt in the bike race.

zh: 比赛很快就要开始了，我们去找座位吧。
en: The game starts {soon|shortly}, so let's find our seats.

zh: 我不太爱运动，不过我确实喜欢看橄榄球。
en: I'm not very sporty. I do like watching rugby, {though|however}.
